critical_traps: Strict contraindication with St. John's Wort (Hypericum perforatum) and 5-HTP due to fatal Serotonin Syndrome.
Increased bleeding risk when combined with high-dose Omega-3 (>3g/day), Ginkgo Biloba, or NSAIDs.
Grapefruit juice inhibits intestinal CYP3A4, causing 300-1400% surge in statin blood levels and severe rhabdomyolysis.
Statins deplete endogenous Coenzyme Q10 synthesis; co-administration of 100-200mg Ubiquinol required to mitigate myalgia.
High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU), Garlic extract, Ginkgo Biloba, and High-Dose Curcumin augment hemorrhage risk.
Variable dietary Vitamin K (spinach, kale) drastically alters Warfarin INR values.
Potassium supplements or salt substitutes (Potassium chloride) cause life-threatening hyperkalemia.
NSAIDs (Ibuprofen, Naproxen) blunt antihypertensive efficacy and trigger acute kidney injury (triple whammy effect).
Severe gastroparesis delays absorption of all oral medications; oral contraceptives and critical narrow-therapeutic drugs must be timed carefully.
Metformin chronically impairs ileal Vitamin B12 absorption; annual serum B12 and methylmalonic acid testing mandatory.
Calcium carbonate, Iron supplements, and Soy protein bind levothyroxine in gut lumen; space ingestion by at least 4 hours.
Biotin (Vitamin B7 >5mg) causes falsely normal/elevated T4 and suppressed TSH in immunoassays without altering actual thyroid status.
Combining NSAIDs with SSRIs increases gastrointestinal bleeding risk by 700%.
Chronic concurrent use of Acetaminophen + Alcohol increases risk of acute toxic hepatocyte necrosis.
Long-term hypochlorhydria causes malabsorption of Magnesium, Calcium, Iron, and Vitamin B12, accelerating osteopenia and hypomagnesemia.
Space oral iron supplements or switch to bisglycinate/effervescent vitamin C.
